name: calendar_freebusy_query
description: Returns free/busy information for a set of calendars, computed from their non-transparent, non-cancelled events (recurring events are expanded). (POST /freeBusy)

time_min.description: The start of the interval for the query formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp.

time_max.description: The end of the interval for the query formatted as an RFC3339 timestamp.

items.description: List of calendars to query, as objects with an 'id' field, e.g. [{"id": "00000000000000000002"}]. Bare string IDs are also accepted.

time_zone.description: Time zone used in the response. Optional. The default is UTC; busy blocks are always reported in UTC in this sandbox.
